meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

copy.tagline_en: Manage annotated matrices for single-cell analysis.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能创建、读取、写入 AnnData 对象,处理 .h5ad、zarr 等数据文件;支持按条件子集、合并多个数据集,以及配合 Scanpy 等工具做单细胞分析。
howto.when: 当用户提到 .h5ad 或 zarr 文件、要求读写 AnnData 对象,或涉及单细胞数据与 scverse 生态工具集成时触发。

say.text: 读取这个 data.h5ad,告诉我有多少细胞和基因。
say.note: 调用 read_h5ad 并输出 n_obs×n_vars。

say.text: 用 backed 模式打开大文件,过滤掉质量分低于 0.8 的细胞。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, read, and write AnnData objects, handle .h5ad or zarr files, subset/filter data, concatenate datasets, and work with scverse tools like Scanpy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions .h5ad or zarr files, asks to read/write AnnData objects, or works with single-cell data and scverse ecosystem tools.

say_en.text: Read this data.h5ad and tell me the number of cells and genes.
Merge batch1 and batch2 h5ad files, adding a batch label column.
Open a large file in backed mode and filter out cells with quality score below 0.8.
say_en.note: Uses read_h5ad(backed='r') then subsets by obs condition.
